name: Jenni & Roger: Domesticated
overview: In this docuseries, we follow Jenni (JWOWW), her hilarious husband, Roger and their two rambunctious kids, Meilani and Greyson, as they let us in on all different routines within their day-in-a-life. From their morning routine to dinner routine and everything in between, this family is always living their lives out-loud with no filter.
